verdict.rationale: Relay's docs confirm the ability to issue cards, set spend limits, define roles, and grant role-based access to team members (relay-docs-2, relay-docs-16, relay-docs-26, relay-docs-31), plus multi-step approval rules (relay-docs-17) and independent confirmation of concrete card limits (relay-comm-4). Community reviews note occasional friction with 'prescribed limits' (relay-comm-2), a minor caveat rather than a functional failure. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation on configuring granular per-employee/per-category controls beyond basic spend limits, and stronger independent hands-on validation of the limit-setting workflow.
